lines.text: OMEGA's throttled, but Exitwell isn't sticking around to watch. He's evacuating the board to the Ark, a private launch platform offshore.
lines.spoken: Omega's throttled, but Exitwell isn't sticking around to watch. He's evacuating the board to the Ark, a private launch platform offshore.

lines.text: Attention, board members. The tender departs shortly. Please leave your conscience at the gate. It will not fit in the overhead bin.

lines.text: Get through the container yard. Once you're through the gate, that boat starts its engines. Run.
